Serial no. 87  [G.S.D]
 CRM (M) 429 of 2026  In re : An Application for Bail under Section 439 of the Code of  Criminal Procedure, 1973/under Section 483 of the BNSS, 2023 in  connection with C/Spl Case No. 118 of 2024 arising out of Berhampore  Police Station Case No. 1298 of 2024 dated 01.09.2024 u/s 376(3) of
the  IPC and Section 6 of the POCSO Act.

-And-  In the matter of : Mahammad Ata @ Md. Atta Sk  ... Petitioner(s  Mr. Rajdeep Mazumder, Sr Adv.
 Mr. Sayan Mukherjee  Mr. Anisur Rahaman  ... for the Petitioner(s)
 Ms. Sreyashee Biswas  Ms. Nandini Chatterjee  ... for the State-respondent(s)
Learned advocate for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is in custody for about seven months and there were relationship between the petitioner and the victim.
Subsequently, the present case has been initiated.

Learned advocate for the State opposes the prayer for bail and has drawn the attention of the Court to the statement of the victim under Section 183 of the BNSS as well as the medicolegal examination report.
It has been pointed out that the petitioner was absconding at the initial stages for a period of one year two months.

However, on an assessment of the materials adduced by the State, particularly, the statement of the victim under Section 183 of the BNSS and the medicolegal examination report, at this stage, the contentions advanced by the petitioner do not inspire this court to release him on bail.
Hence, the prayer for bail of the petitioner is Rejected.
